task1_source_records.S1_partner_load: the other load of the two-load matching code; fraction of active pairs whose partner fixes the source L-independently (LNAT2 says 1/3: to verify on all 30 seams, both colorings)
task1_source_records.S2_twist_register: committed rule register (oph_defects DATASET.md section 1): delta = j mod 6 on the two faces of the seam; which active events it records; what it records when coupled to the coherent event
task1_source_records.S3_tape_end_tape_pos: observer tape fields (DATASET.md section 7, universe.py _tape_rows): do they depend on the loads at all
task1_source_records.S4_consensus_slice_order: causal depth and consistent cuts (DATASET.md section 1): do they depend on the loads
task1_source_records.S5_address_orientation: the walk's oriented address register: correlation with the source endpoint
task1_source_records.S6_committed_coin_current: the committed record (coin, current) of model/observer/native.py: control, classical
task1_source_records.S7_coherent_record_conjugate_basis: the owned parity record of the coherent event read in the basis (|0> +- |1>)/sqrt2 (hypothesis: the event is a SWAP of the port qubit in the p/m basis with the record)
task1_source_records.S8_endpoint_occupation_read: a detector of the occupation of one or both seam endpoints before the coherent event (apparatus class: owned-register detector)

compositions.C1_two_reads_fresh_record: the same seam event twice with a fresh second record
compositions.C2_two_reads_reused_record: the same seam event twice on the same record (U^2)
compositions.C3_previous_tick_record: the walk's record after tick t, as information on the endpoint at tick t+1
compositions.C4_partner_controlled_correction: any unitary on the record controlled by the partner position (bound on the tracial polarization)
compositions.C5_record_preserving_correction: any isometry controlled by the record value 0/1 acting on everything else (Procrustes bound ||M||_1/6)
compositions.C6_controlled_half_turn: apply gC when the load sits on the second endpoint (injectivity test)

task1_source_records.readout_at_fraction_f: A-clock energies E_k = a^2 + 4 b^2 cos^2(theta_k) + 4 f a b cos(theta_k), a = 1/sqrt6, b = 1/sqrt12, theta = 2/9: report Q, effective |b|/a, effective delta and the two ratios for f = 1/3 (and f = 0, 1 as controls)

task2_analyzers.A2_modular_flow: rho^{it}, rho = [(5/4) I + (W + W*)/2]/524, one object and two objects
task2_analyzers.A3_CF1_alternating_order: S_fwd = (Q3 R)(Q2 R)(Q1 R), S_rev reversed (candidates/CF1.md section 8)
task2_analyzers.A4_consensus_average: A* and R = 2 A A* - I of the coherent walk; product over objects
task2_analyzers.A5_heralded_filter: (2 I + W)/3, the one native linear combination of unitaries (added by this lane)
task2_analyzers.test: unitary; native (in the declared grammar); maps the three flags (E hold, C rot+, C rot-) to the Fourier vector (equal moduli in the flag-zero row); Schmidt rank across the two objects
